306: "They came, the Children of Israel, the entire community, to the Wilderness of Tzin" (Numbers 20:1). Rabbi Yehudah said: Why is the section of the [red] heifer adjacent to the death of Miriam? We have established it - it is only to because (other versions, in as much as) a verdict was executed on that heifer, to purify the impure; a verdict was executed on Miriam, to purify the world. So she departed from the world. Once Miriam departed, that well that went with the Jewish people in the desert [also] departed. And the Well departed in everything.

Rabbi Abba said: It is written, "And you, son of man, take up a dirge for Maiden Israel." And is it only for her? No. Rather, it is because everything was broken because of Her. Because of Her, the Right Arm was broken behind Her, that was bringing Her close to the Body. And the Body - which is the Sun - was darkened because of Her. And that is the secret that is written (Psalms 60:7), "deliver with Your right arm and answer me." The Body, for (other versions, Because of Her, as it is written [Isaiah 13:10], "The sun shall be dark when it rises"; and) it is written (Isaiah 50:3), "I clothe the skies in blackness." For behold the Sun was darkened because of Her. In this way, "and Miriam died there, etc."

"And there was no water for the community" (Numbers 20:2). As behold the higher Well and the lower well departed. Afterwards, the Right Arm was broken, as it is written (Numbers 20:24), "And Aharon shall be gathered to his people." And afterwards the Sun was darkened, as it is written (Deuteronomy 32:50), "And die on the mountain, etc. and be gathered unto your people, etc." The  forearm of the Right Arm was broken; and the Body, which is the Sun, was darkened.

And come and see: There has never been a generation in the world like the generation when Moshe was living in the world, and Aharon and Miriam! And if you say, so too in the days of Shlomo, it is not so. For behold, in the days of Shlomo, the Moon was ruling and the Sun was withdrawn; but in the days of Moshe, the Moon was withdrawn and the Sun was ruling.
